data.heading: The
data.text: A cell is the basic unit of a living being.
The nerve cells in the brain send and receive messages.
The blood cells carry oxygen around the body.
The nucleus is the control centre of the cell which controls the cell's growth and reproduction.
The cytoplasm moves materials around the cell and also helps in dissolving waste.
The cell membrane acts as a protective wall for the cell. It separates one cell from another.
Vacuoles are fluid sacs that store food and minerals for the cell.
